findings.title: Materials' 55-point lens gap signals collapse
findings.body: Materials' trailing P/E sits at the 88th percentile while its forward P/E is at the 32nd, a 55-point divergence. That gap implies analysts expect 114 percent earnings growth, a bet on a profit explosion that would be extraordinary even for a cyclical at the bottom of its cycle.

findings.title: Staples' forward cheapness hides earnings risk
findings.body: Consumer Staples' forward P/E has fallen 27 percentile points in a month to the 17th, yet its trailing P/E remains at the 79th percentile. The market is pricing in 43 percent earnings growth, but the speed of the de-rating suggests doubts about whether that growth is achievable.

findings.title: Communication Services is historically cheap
findings.body: Communication Services trades at a forward P/E of 13.68, the 1st percentile of its five-year range, while its trailing multiple is at the 27th. The 26-point gap reflects an expectation of 56 percent earnings growth, but the valuation is already pricing in a severe earnings disappointment.
